description: Sandbox: create a spending wallet for an AI agent, with a per-payout cap and the only phone numbers it may pay. Fund it, then issue its ak_test_ key. In production a human sets up agent wallets.

allowed_recipient_phones.description: 1 to 20 distinct numbers this wallet may pay

approval_above_limit.description: Sandbox: a payout above the caps waits for the owner's approval instead of failing

approval_max_amount.description: With approval_above_limit: hard ceiling, at least max_payout_amount; nothing above it can be approved, in whole XOF (F CFA). Integer, no decimals: 5000 = 5 000 F CFA.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.

max_daily_amount.description: Optional cap on the wallet's payouts per day (Dakar time), in whole XOF (F CFA). Integer, no decimals: 5000 = 5 000 F CFA.

max_payout_amount.description: Largest single payout, in whole XOF (F CFA). Integer, no decimals: 5000 = 5 000 F CFA.

name: xaalis_create_agent_wallet
title: Create an agent wallet (sandbox)
